title: Days on the water
lede: From a traditional llaüt for a morning to a crewed yacht for a week — a boat turns Ibiza into an island again.
image_alt: A motor yacht at speed on the Mediterranean off Ibiza

sections.title: No roads, no queues, no plans beyond the next cove
paragraphs: We arrange boats of every size for every kind of day: a quiet swim at Cala Mastella, a long lunch at Cala Jondal, the cliffs of Es Vedrà at golden hour, or the crossing to Formentera with the family.

Every booking includes a licensed skipper, fuel for the agreed itinerary, and the equipment you need for the day. We will plan the route around the wind, the crowds and the light — and we will tell you honestly if the weather suggests another day.
Boats can be booked by the day, the half-day or the week. For groups of ten or more, a crewed yacht is often better value than two day boats.

sections.title: What comes with the boat
items: A licensed skipper and crew where required
A cool box with water, soft drinks and ice
Lunch on board or a table on the beach, arranged in advance
Hotel or villa transfers to the marina

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: In July and August, the best skippers are usually booked several weeks ahead. For June, September and October, a week or two is often enough.
Yes. We will suggest a route based on the wind, the season and what you want from the day — and adjust it if the weather changes.
No. Every boat we arrange comes with a licensed skipper. If you hold a licence and want to charter bareboat, tell us and we will find the right operator.

items.q: What happens if the weather turns?
items.a: Safety comes first. If the skipper decides the day cannot go ahead, we will rebook or refund according to the operator's terms — and we will tell you before you leave the villa.

sections.title: Tell us about your day on the water
sections.text: Send your dates, the size of your group and whether you would like a skipper, lunch or both.
